identity.title: Complete typed ROI Crop preparation output

origin.kind: owner continuation request and current master backlog
origin.summary: The owner resumed the next dependency-ready software slice: complete ROI/Crop as a typed preparation tool rather than a catalog-only entry.

state.current_summary: ROI/Crop now creates an immutable SDK-owned smaller HeightField, preserves exact mask and source-grid origin, supports explicit Workbench Preview/Publish and compatible later-tool teaching, replays in Runner, survives save/reopen, and has current Release, structure, package, Wide/Compact, and diff-hygiene evidence.

objective.summary: Create a deterministic smaller HeightField from one explicit source-bound GridRectangle and expose it through Studio Preview, Publish, ordered Run, and reusable evidence.
constraints: ROI/Crop produces the selected rectangular grid only; it is not the separate Reduce Domain/Mask feature.
Preserve exact row-major finite and missing values, source frame and unit, root-source identity, and the crop's source-grid row and column origin.
Preview, Publish, Run, and recipe editing remain explicit actions; teaching or editing the ROI must not execute the tool.
The source remains selected and unchanged; Preview and Publish create a separate derived output.
Numerical crop ownership belongs to a public sealed OpenVisionLab.Vision3D tool consumed through a pinned vendored package.
Do not expand this slice into Reduce Domain/Mask, general import, calibration, physical metrology, or human R0.

criteria.text: A public sealed Vision SDK crop tool validates one HeightMapRoi, returns a controlled typed result, preserves row-major finite and NaN values, advances the output origin by the selected row and column, and honors cancellation.

The Studio adapter requires one exact source-bound GridRectangle and creates a separate immutable C3DHeightFieldSnapshot with explicit output identity, root-source SHA-256, source-grid origin, unit, frame, dimensions, counts, metrics, overlays, and provenance.

The existing Workbench surface executes ROI/Crop only through Preview, supports cancellation and stale-result invalidation, displays the derived C3D without replacing the source, and Publish registers the exact Preview result without re-running.
Ordered Shell and Runner replay execute ROI/Crop deterministically from the saved recipe, expose output hash and crop-region evidence, and stop on invalid or stale source identity.
Save/reopen preserves the authored crop region and reproduces the same output identity; source bytes and active source selection remain unchanged.
Focused SDK, adapter, Workbench, ordered-Runner, persistence, current-build Wide and Compact runtime UI, proportional Release build, structure, and diff-hygiene checks pass with D-backed evidence.

context.summary: ROI/Crop is cataloged and already requests one GridRectangle, but all execution falls through to unrelated filter behavior.
The current public SDK has HeightMap3D and HeightMapRoi but no crop tool.
Product-owner Wide/Compact R0 remains explicitly deferred.

Workbench verification passed 19/19 for explicit Preview/Publish, exact derived output and Viewer request, artifact/compare evidence, Published crop identity, compatible later Warpage teaching and execution, source preservation, save/reopen, two-step ordered replay, and dependent stale invalidation.
The complete Studio Release solution built with zero warnings and zero errors after the final downstream-input and stale-state changes.
The final code-structure guard passed 68/68 with explicit HeightMapCropTool ownership, zero migration debt, 34 reviewed boundaries, and the exact vendored package verifier also passed.

Current final Release EXE Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 ROI/Crop Preview screenshots passed image-quality and open-lifecycle checks on the dynamically selected left monitor at the available 125% scale; visual review found no required-text clipping, overlap, or off-pane crop evidence.
Final git diff --check passed; the modified JSON documents parsed, root/docs README local links resolved, and PL-0037 validated as a resolved v2 issue.
